answer: Attestation weight is the square of stake: (stake / 1000)^2 times 1000. One honest peer staking 5,000 POA carries weight 25,000. A farmer who splits that same 5,000 into fifty clones of 100 POA gives each clone weight 10, and all fifty sum to 500, so fragmentation alone drops his voice from 25,000 to 500. Matching the honest peer costs 5,000 in each clone, 250,000 locked, against 5,000 for one identity. Every fragment drags the farm toward that nadir. Yarrow looks like a hundred flowers on one root; a reef holds as one colony while the same limestone ground to sand is only the seafloor.
